now.title: Agent Carter S1#7
now.text: Dottie Underwood tails SSR agent Ray Krzeminski while he is transporting a witness and kills him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An SSR agent Dottie tails and kills.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Tails Krzeminski while he transports a witness, and kills him.

changes.evidence: Dottie kills Krzeminski in 'Time and Tide' (Agent Carter S1#3): she rams his car at a red light while he drives the captured guard Jerome Zandow to the SSR, shoots him when he gets out, then kills Zandow. S1#7 ('SNAFU') has no such event; Krzeminski is only mentioned there.

now.title: Agent Carter S1#6
now.text: Dottie knocks Peggy out with a kiss, and Peggy sees that she is the Leviathan operative. From then on they fight more than once.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Dottie's hotel friend and secret target. They fight once Dottie's cover is gone.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A hotel friend who secretly spies on Peggy for Leviathan, then fights her.

proposed.text: Dottie knocks Peggy out with a drugged kiss, and as she falls Peggy sees the handcuff scars that mark Dottie as the Leviathan operative.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Dottie's hotel friend and secret target, knocked out by her drugged kiss.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A hotel friend who secretly spies on Peggy for Leviathan, then knocks her out.

changes.evidence: In 'A Sin to Err' (S1#6) Dottie only knocks Peggy out with Sweet Dreams Lipstick and draws a knife before Thompson and Sousa arrive; there is no fight. Their fights come later (S1#8 'Valediction', where Peggy kicks her through a window), so 'From then on they fight more than once' and the card lines' fighting tell later episodes' events.
